correctness.rationale: From the known exact variance series, summation and derivative algebra give S'(q)=H(q)/q³ and H''(q)=qR(q)/(1-q²)², where R'(q)=2(q+1)(3q-4)<0. This proves one curvature switch for H, one maximum of H, and exactly one zero of H after that maximum, hence one global maximizer of S. H'(q*)<0 proves positive quadratic stability. The source variance formula, q-boundaries, endpoint behavior, and fixed-theta quantifiers were independently checked. Exact rational logarithm bounds certify the root bracket.
